steps.title: Teleological Argument
steps.body: Argument for God's existence based on evidence of design, purpose, and order in the universe (Paley's Watchmaker).

steps.title: Categorical Imperative
steps.body: Kant's deontological moral command: act only according to maxims you can universalise as universal law.
